name: What should I ask a contractor before hiring them for an office build-out?

mainEntity.name: Which contractor questions reveal whether they actually understand office tenant improvements in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Which contractor questions reveal whether they actually understand office tenant improvements in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong contractor interview should go beyond general licensing and insurance questions. Ask how many office build-outs they have completed recently in the Los Angeles area, whether they have experience in occupied buildings, how they manage permit delays, who your day-to-day contact will be, and how they handle budget updates and change orders. Also ask about long-lead materials, communication frequency, and references from projects similar in size and finish level. For offices in Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood, local building familiarity matters because each property can have different approval and access rules. The best contractor should be able to explain risks before work starts and provide a realistic plan for managing them. If the answers are vague or overly optimistic, that is a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about comparable recent projects, who will manage the job day to day, how budget updates are handled, how changes are documented, and how the schedule is managed in occupied buildings. Those answers show whether the contractor has real office build-out experience.
